function.name: bitmap_info_size
function.description: This function calculates the size of a bitmap information structure, taking into account the color usage and the type of bitmap header.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap information structure

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies the usage of color in the bitmap

function.return_type: int, represents the size of the bitmap information structure in bytes

function.name: is_valid_dib_format
function.description: This function checks if the provided DIB format is valid or not. It checks various conditions related to width, height, compression, size, bit count, and planes of the BITMAPINFOHEADER. It also checks for size overflow.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the BITMAPINFOHEADER structure that contains information about the dimensions and color format of a DIB.

parameters.name: allow_compression
parameters.description: This parameter determines if compression is allowed or not.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the DIB format is valid, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: bitmapinfoheader_from_user_bitmapinfo
function.description: This function converts a user provided bitmap info into a bitmap info header. It checks the size of the provided info and based on that, it either converts a core header into a bitmap info header or directly copies the info into the destination. If the size is not recognized, it warns the user and returns false.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination pointer where the converted or copied info will be stored.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: This is the source pointer from where the info is to be converted or copied.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the conversion or copy was successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: bitmapinfo_from_user_bitmapinfo
function.description: This function validates and converts a user-provided bitmap information structure to a system-recognized format.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitmap information structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the source user-provided bitmap information structure.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies how the color table is used for color bitmaps.

parameters.name: allow_compression
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether compression is allowed or not.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the conversion is successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: fill_color_table_from_palette
function.description: This function fills a color table from a palette. It calculates the number of colors based on the bit count in the bitmap info header, then retrieves the palette entries and sets the color values in the bitmap info color table.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the dimensions of color format for a DIB.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

function.return_type: int, represents the number of colors in the color table. If the palette is not available or the palette entries could not be retrieved, the function returns 0.

function.name: fill_color_table_from_pal_colors
function.description: This function fills a color table from palette colors. It gets the palette entries, fills the RGBQUAD table with the corresponding colors, and then copies this table into the bmiColors field of the BITMAPINFO structure. If there are any unused entries in the bmiColors field, it sets them to zero.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure. This structure contains information about the dimensions and color format of a DIB. The function modifies the bmiColors field of this structure.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to a device context. The function uses this handle to retrieve the current palette.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully fills the color table, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: get_pixel_ptr
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a specific pixel in a bitmap image.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap information structure.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap pixel data.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate of the pixel.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate of the pixel.

function.return_type: void pointer. It represents the address of the pixel at the specified x and y coordinates.

function.name: build_rle_bitmap
function.description: This function builds a run-length encoded bitmap from the given parameters.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the dimensions and color format of a DIB.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to a gdi_image_bits structure that contains information about the bitmap bits.

parameters.name: clip
parameters.description: Pointer to a HRGN structure that defines the clipping region.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully builds the bitmap, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: nulldrv_StretchDIBits
function.description: This function is used to stretch or compress the bitmap image to the dimensions specified by the destination rectangle. If the dimensions of the source rectangle and destination rectangle are not the same, the source bitmap is stretched or compressed to fit the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context to be used

parameters.name: xDst
parameters.description: x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: yDst
parameters.description: y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: widthDst
parameters.description: Width of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: heightDst
parameters.description: Height of the destination rectangle

parameters.name: xSrc
parameters.description: x-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the source rectangle

parameters.name: ySrc
parameters.description: y-coordinate of the upper-left corner of the source rectangle

parameters.name: widthSrc
parameters.description: Width of the source rectangle

parameters.name: heightSrc
parameters.description: Height of the source rectangle

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap bits

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bmiColors member of the BITMAPINFO structure contains explicit red, green, blue, and alpha values or indexes

parameters.name: rop
parameters.description: Raster operation code. These codes define how the color data for the source rectangle is to be combined with the color data for the destination rectangle to achieve the final color

function.return_type: INT, represents the height of the original bitmap if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns 0.

function.name: NtGdiStretchDIBitsInternal
function.description: This function is used to stretch or compress the bitmap image and copy the color data for the rectangle it defines into the specified destination rectangle.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the destination device context.

parameters.name: xDst
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: yDst
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: widthDst
parameters.description: The width, in logical units, of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: heightDst
parameters.description: The height, in logical units, of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: xSrc
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the lower-left corner of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: ySrc
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the lower-left corner of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: widthSrc
parameters.description: The width, in logical units, of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: heightSrc
parameters.description: The height, in logical units, of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the bitmap bits.

parameters.name: bmi
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bmiColors member of the BITMAPINFO structure contains explicit red, green, blue color data or a palette index.

parameters.name: rop
parameters.description: A raster-operation code.

parameters.name: max_info
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of information to be updated in the bitmap info.

parameters.name: max_bits
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum amount of bits to be updated in the bitmap.

parameters.name: xform
parameters.description: Handle to the transformation to be applied.

function.return_type: INT, represents the height of the source bitmap if the function succeeds. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: set_di_bits
function.description: This function sets the bits of a device-independent bitmap (DIB) to the specified values.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: Handle to the bitmap.

parameters.name: startscan
parameters.description: Specifies the starting scan line of the array.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: Specifies the number of scan lines found in the array.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of DIB bits.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bmiColors member of the BITMAPINFO structure contains explicit red, green, blue (RGB) values or indexes.

function.return_type: int, represents the number of scan lines set, or zero if the function fails.

function.name: nulldrv_SetDIBitsToDevice
function.description: This function sets the pixels in a rectangle of a device context using color data from a DIB.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x_dst
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: y_dst
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: The width, in logical units, of the rectangle.

parameters.name: cy
parameters.description: The height, in logical units, of the rectangle.

parameters.name: x_src
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the source rectangle in the DIB.

parameters.name: y_src
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the source rectangle in the DIB.

parameters.name: startscan
parameters.description: The starting scan line in the DIB.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: The number of DIB scan lines to set in the device context.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the DIB bits, which are an array of bytes.

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bmiColors member of the BITMAPINFO structure contains explicit red, green, blue color data or a palette index.

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of scan lines set, zero indicates failure.

function.name: NtGdiSetDIBitsToDeviceInternal
function.description: This function sets the pixels in a rectangle of a Windows device context using color data from a DIB.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

parameters.name: xDest
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: yDest
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: cx
parameters.description: The width, in logical units, of the rectangle.

parameters.name: cy
parameters.description: The height, in logical units, of the rectangle.

parameters.name: xSrc
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the lower-left corner of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: ySrc
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the lower-left corner of the source rectangle.

parameters.name: startscan
parameters.description: The starting scan line in the source bitmap.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: The number of scan lines found in the array pointed to by the lpvBits parameter.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: A pointer to the color data stored in a DIB format.

parameters.name: bmi
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bmiColors member of the BITMAPINFO structure contains explicit red, green, blue color values or indexes.

parameters.name: max_bits
parameters.description: The maximum number of bits that can be set.

parameters.name: max_info
parameters.description: The maximum amount of information that can be set.

parameters.name: xform_coords
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether the coordinates should be transformed.

parameters.name: xform
parameters.description: A handle to the transformation if xform_coords is TRUE.

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of scan lines set, or zero if the function fails.

function.name: set_dib_dc_color_table
function.description: This function sets the color table of a device-independent bitmap (DIB) for a device context (DC).

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: startpos
parameters.description: The starting position in the color table where colors should be set.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: The number of color entries to set.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of RGBQUAD structures containing color data.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of color entries that were actually set in the color table.

function.name: get_dib_dc_color_table
function.description: This function retrieves a specified range of color table entries from the DIB section of a specified device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: startpos
parameters.description: Specifies the first color table entry to retrieve.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Specifies the number of color table entries to retrieve.

parameters.name: colors
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of RGBQUAD structures to receive the color table entries.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of color table entries actually retrieved.

function.name: fill_query_info
function.description: This function fills the bitmap information for a given bitmap object and returns the height of the bitmap.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that will be filled with the bitmap information.

parameters.name: bmp
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPOBJ structure that contains the bitmap object to be queried.

function.return_type: int, represents the height of the bitmap.

function.name: copy_color_info
function.description: This function copies color information from a source BITMAPINFO structure to a destination BITMAPINFO structure, based on the color usage parameter.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination BITMAPINFO structure where color information will be copied.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source BITMAPINFO structure from where color information will be copied.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies the color usage. It can be DIB_PAL_COLORS or DIB_RGB_COLORS.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: get_default_color_table
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a color table based on the bits per pixel (bpp) value provided. It defines three color tables for 1, 4, and 8 bpp respectively and returns the appropriate one.

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: This parameter represents the bits per pixel for which the color table is required.

function.return_type: RGBQUAD pointer, representing the color table corresponding to the provided bits per pixel value.

function.name: fill_default_color_table
function.description: This function fills the default color table of a given BITMAPINFO structure.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to the BITMAPINFO structure whose color table is to be filled.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return any value

function.name: get_ddb_bitmapinfo
function.description: This function sets the properties of a BITMAPINFO structure using the values from a BITMAPOBJ structure.

parameters.name: bmp
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPOBJ structure that contains the bitmap information to be used.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that will be filled with the bitmap information from the BITMAPOBJ structure.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the BITMAPINFO structure pointed to by the 'info' parameter.

function.name: copy_packed_dib
function.description: This function copies a packed device-independent bitmap (DIB) from a source BITMAPINFO structure to a newly allocated BITMAPINFO structure, and returns a pointer to the new structure.

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: A pointer to the source BITMAPINFO structure that contains the DIB to be copied.

parameters.name: usage
parameters.description: Specifies the usage of the DIB. This parameter can be one of the following values: DIB_RGB_COLORS or DIB_PAL_COLORS.

function.return_type: BITMAPINFO pointer. It represents a pointer to the newly allocated BITMAPINFO structure that contains the copied DIB. If the function fails, it returns NULL.

function.name: NtGdiGetDIBitsInternal
function.description: This function retrieves the bits of a specified compatible bitmap and copies them into a buffer using the specified format.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: A handle to the device context.

parameters.name: hbitmap
parameters.description: A handle to the bitmap.

parameters.name: startscan
parameters.description: The first scan line to retrieve.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: The number of scan lines to retrieve.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer to receive the bitmap data.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that specifies the desired format for the bitmap data.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: The expected usage of the color table in the BITMAPINFO structure.

parameters.name: max_bits
parameters.description: The maximum number of bits that the function can set.

parameters.name: max_info
parameters.description: The maximum number of BITMAPINFO structures that the function can return.

function.return_type: INT. The function returns the number of scan lines copied from the bitmap into the buffer, or 0 if the function fails.

function.name: NtGdiCreateDIBitmapInternal
function.description: This function creates a device-independent bitmap (DIB) that applications can write to directly. The function gives you a pointer to the location of the bitmap bit values.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The bitmap width, in pixels.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The bitmap height, in pixels.

parameters.name: init
parameters.description: Specifies whether the bitmap is initialized.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of bytes that contains the initial bitmap data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that describes the dimensions and color format of the bitmap.

parameters.name: coloruse
parameters.description: Specifies how the system interprets values in the color table of the BITMAPINFO structure.

parameters.name: max_info
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of BITMAPINFO structures that the function can process.

parameters.name: max_bits
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum number of bytes that the function can add to the bitmap.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies one or more flags.

parameters.name: xform
parameters.description: Handle to the transformation.

function.return_type: HBITMAP. It represents the handle to the DIB if the function is successful. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiCreateDIBSection
function.description: This function creates a DIB section that applications can write to directly. It is used to create a device-independent bitmap (DIB) that applications can write to directly.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Handle to a file-mapping object that the function will use to create the DIB.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the offset from the beginning of the file-mapping object referenced by section.

parameters.name: bmi
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the DIB.

parameters.name: usage
parameters.description: Specifies the type of color indices that should be used for the bitmap.

parameters.name: header_size
parameters.description: Specifies the size of the DIB header.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies flags that control the type of DIB to be created.

parameters.name: color_space
parameters.description: Specifies the color space of the DIB.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives a pointer to the location of the DIB bit values.

function.return_type: HBITMAP. If the function succeeds, the return value is a handle to the DIB section. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.

function.name: memory_dib_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a memory device-independent bitmap (DIB) object, freeing its associated resources.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the DIB object to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the DIB object was successfully deleted, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDICreateDCFromMemory
function.description: This function creates a device context (DC) for a bitmap from memory, using the specified format, width, height, and pitch. It also handles the allocation of necessary resources and error checking.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a structure that contains information about the bitmap to be created, including its format, width, height, pitch, device DC, color table, and memory location.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the function execution. It returns STATUS_SUCCESS if the function executes successfully. If there is an error (e.g., invalid parameters or memory allocation failure), it returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER.

function.name: NtGdiDdDDIDestroyDCFromMemory
function.description: This function destroys a device context (DC) and its associated bitmap from memory. It checks if the given parameters are valid and of the correct type, deletes the bitmap and the DC, and then returns a status code.

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a D3DKMT_DESTROYDCFROMMEMORY structure that describes the DC and the bitmap to be destroyed.

function.return_type: NTSTATUS, which represents the status of the operation. It returns STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER if the input parameter is null or if the objects are not of the correct type, and STATUS_SUCCESS if the operation is successful.

function.name: DIB_GetObject
function.description: This function retrieves information for a specified graphics object. Depending on the second parameter, this function can return different types of objects.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Handle to the graphics object

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Specifies the number of bytes of information to be written to the buffer

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the information about the specified graphics object

function.return_type: INT, represents the number of bytes stored into the buffer

function.name: DIB_DeleteObject
function.description: This function deletes a bitmap object associated with the given handle. It frees the memory allocated for the bitmap object and its color table.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is a handle to the bitmap object that needs to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the bitmap object is successfully deleted, otherwise returns FALSE.
